articles.title: UK financial regulator moves to allow mutual funds 10% exposure to crypto ETNs
articles.snippet: The Financial Conduct Authority proposed allowing some investment schemes to add exposure to crypto exchange-traded notes.

articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: AAVE Drops 2.6% as all constituents trade lower
articles.snippet: Uniswap (UNI), down 2.9% from Monday, joined Aave (AAVE) as an underperformer.

articles.title: Humanity's $36 million exploit tied to compromised laptop hosting a 'multisig' wallet
articles.snippet: The compromised laptop held enough multisig keys to take over the project's bridges on two chains, a basic security failure for a startup backed by Pantera and Jump Crypto.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin drops to $62,600 as some traders peg SpaceX's IPO as 'next catalyst'
articles.snippet: Stocks recovered through SpaceX's oversubscribed IPO, an Nvidia and SK Hynix chip pact, and Apple's AI reboot, while crypto trailed.

articles.title: Chinese mining CEO says Strategy can survive a $30,000 bitcoin without selling
articles.snippet: Jiang Zhuoer of BTC.TOP called the week's selloff speculation overblown, arguing Strategy's small debt and the design of its preferred shares let it keep buying.
